foundation.material: m25_hair_foundation / m25_hair_body: asset albedo (near-black, sRGB mean 0.07/0.03/0.03), metallic 0, roughness ≥ 0.55, normal map strength 0.6

primary.construction: axis grown down the outer hair surface (4 mm steps, gravity + surface projection, skin push-out), helix of radius 3.4–6.2 mm and pitch 10–16 mm around it, root relaxed over 15 mm, tip tightened 15 %, swept as a 6-sided rounded tube of clump radius 1.3–2.0 mm with smooth normals

secondary.construction: flyaways: 20–70 mm curled 3-sided fibres (0.16–0.28 mm radius) leaving the outer surface; baby hairs: 8–20 mm spirals laid 0.4 mm off the forehead skin along the hairline

skinning: Head weight 1 above 1.50 m, blended linearly to Spine02 by 1.30 m
notDone: no strand simulation or grooming tool
ringlets are not separated into editable clusters beyond one object per layer
no per-strand UVs / textures: colour variation is by material (curl vs highlight)
